findings.title: Modified monitor config copy is discarded in context
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` and replaces `schedule_type` with the human-readable display value, but the returned context uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified `config`. The normalization is therefore lost, so the emitted monitor context contains the raw `schedule_type` value rather than the intended display value.
